pyqgis_plugin.name: Add Transparency Slider
pyqgis_plugin.description: Adds an 'Add / Remove transparency slider' item to the layer tree context menu to quickly manage embedded opacity sliders beneath layers.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Adds a convenient context menu action in the QGIS layer panel (as the 6th item) to conditionally add or remove the embedded transparency (opacity) slider for map layers with a single click.
